title: Absolute moment of a heterogeneous biased monomial
statement:
Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, choose parameters $p_i\in(0,1)$ for each $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. Let $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ be independent random signs with $\mathbb{P}(X_i=1)=1-p_i$ and $\mathbb{P}(X_i=-1)=p_i$, and set $\sigma_i=\sqrt{4p_i(1-p_i)}$. Then
\[\mathbb{E}\left[\left|\prod_{i\in S}\frac{X_i-(1-2p_i)}{\sigma_i}\right|\right]=\prod_{i\in S}\sigma_i.\]
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
